title: Cursor
description: Warm paper and ink: a #f7f7f4 page, #f2f1ed panels, a warm near-black #26251e for text and pill buttons, ink-60% secondary text, ink-5% hairlines, 4px corners and a single hot orange for text links. One neo-grotesk at weight 400 throughout, small and quiet except for a big closing line.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in the same spirit (warm near-black page, off-white ink, the same orange)
Hanken Grotesk stands in for CursorGothic (custom); JetBrains Mono for Berkeley Mono (closed)
--page-width is the 1300px content frame; at 1440 the 70px sides come from centring
secondary is the pale pill fill, accent the one-step-darker hover of pills and link cards
name: cursor-theme
